historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa'l-Nihayah, Volume 12, Pages 331-332 The name Ambreen carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ambreen bint Al-Hasan Al-Wazir, the sister of Salahuddin Ayoubi, was the wife of the Seljuk Sultan of Rum, Qutb ad-Din Mahmud. She played a pivotal role in the diplomatic relations between Salahuddin and the Seljuk Sultanate of Rum during the Battle of Hattin.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Mas'udi, Muruj Al-Dhahab, Volume 1, Page 224 The name Ambreen carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ambreen bint Ali, the daughter of Al-Hakim Bi-Amr Allah, was known for her beauty and intelligence. She was married to the Hamdanid ruler of Aleppo, Sayf al-Dawla, and her wise counsel helped him govern effectively.
